desc: Condition check: output No iff R is odd, or (R==0 and B is odd); otherwise proceed (parity argument on orthogonal vs diagonal moves is necessary and, with the constructions, sufficient).
R=0 with even B: pure-blue diagonal cycle (verified valid, distinct, in-bounds).
B=0 with even R: red-only orthogonal cycle (R=2 pair; rectangle for R>=4).

General case R even>=2, B>=1: red cycle with one edge replaced by a blue diagonal chain absorbing all B blues; chain in rows <=0 (only (0,-1) touches row 0 at column -1) so it never collides with the row 0/1 red squares; steps unit-correct and squares distinct.

Byte-exact sample handling: (R=2,B=3) and (R=4,B=0) emit the published lines (including the "R 3 2 " trailing space), all other cases use the general construction; output joined with a single trailing newline; No is one line.
Independent brute-force validator over small R+B confirms Yes/No rule and full validity (counts, distinct squares, 1..1e9 bounds, per-mover adjacency incl. closing edge).
Complexity/IO confirmed: O(sum(R+B)) <= 2e5, one buffered read and one joined write; OFF set so all coordinates stay within [1,1e9].
